_comment: DRAFT placeholder tutorial texts (Demo 01 A0-A4, rev 5c flow 2026-10-13), used only when narrative_manifest.json has no entry for the id (FNarrativeManifest::DraftTutorialTexts). To be replaced by the sheet Tutorial tab (TANDEM request 17). {key:<CommandId>} = the key cap, {focus} = the operative a 'focus' card is about. English only (in-game text).

WT_A0_BRIEFING_1.text: Cold Silence, this is HQ. Drop confirmed. You're on the ice, three klicks south of the Sector-17 weather station.

WT_A0_BRIEFING_2.text: Copy, HQ. Frost in the middle of summer... Somebody really doesn't want us here.

WT_A0_BRIEFING_3.text: The station went dark forty hours ago. Find out why. And keep moving — standing still on that ice will kill you.

WT_A0_01.text: Follow the beacons north. The fishermen marked the safe ice. HQ out.

TUT_A0_NOINVENTORY.text: Not now. Packs stay closed until we need them.

TUT_A0_CAM_PAN.title: CAMERA — MOVE
TUT_A0_CAM_PAN.text: Move the camera with {key:Camera.Pan.Keys} or by pushing the cursor to the screen edge.

TUT_A0_CAM_PAN_DRAG.title: CAMERA — DRAG
TUT_A0_CAM_PAN_DRAG.text: Hold the middle mouse button (the wheel) and drag to pan the camera.

TUT_A0_CAM_ROTATE_MOUSE.title: CAMERA — FREE LOOK
TUT_A0_CAM_ROTATE_MOUSE.text: Hold {key:Camera.Rotate.Mouse} and drag to turn the camera freely.

TUT_A0_MOVE.title: CLICK TO WALK
TUT_A0_MOVE.text: Click the ground ({key:Order.Move}): the squad walks there. Follow the beacons to the amber ring at beacon one.

TUT_A0_NOSPRINT.text: Save your strength - walk for now.

OBJ_A1_CAMP.text: Follow the beacons to the fishing camp

OBJ_A1_HUT.text: Resupply heat packs at the fishermen's hut

WT_A1_01.text: Beacon one. The ice holds out here.

WT_A1_02.text: Steady pace. Nobody gets ahead of the squad.

WT_A1_03.text: Save your breath for the far side. Beacon two is past the crack.

WT_A1_04.text: Crack ahead — and somebody rigged a plank bridge over it. Fishermen's work.

WT_A1_05.text: One at a time — the planks won't hold two.

OBJ_A1_BRIDGE.text: Cross the bridge one at a time

WT_A1_HUT_APPROACH_1.text: We're approaching the house. Go in carefully.

WT_A1_HUT_APPROACH_2.text: Door's open. Could be anything in there.

WT_A1_HUT_APPROACH_3.text: Stack up on the door. One each side, one goes in.

TUT_A1_SELECT.title: SELECT
TUT_A1_SELECT.text: Now pick who moves: press {key:Select.Member} (1 / 2 / 3) or click an operative or his portrait. Your orders go to him alone.

TUT_A1_SOLO.title: SOLO
TUT_A1_SOLO.text: Hold at the door. Press {key:Squad.Solo}: the others hold their spots while one operative moves alone.

TUT_A1_HUT_STACK_L.title: LEFT OF THE DOOR
TUT_A1_HUT_STACK_L.text: Click the wall left of the door (amber ring) to preview the cover, click again: he hugs the wall beside the door.

TUT_A1_HUT_STACK_R.title: RIGHT OF THE DOOR
TUT_A1_HUT_STACK_R.text: Select another operative ({key:Select.Member}) and put him against the wall right of the door.

TUT_A1_HUT_ENTER.title: GO IN
TUT_A1_HUT_ENTER.text: Select the third operative ({key:Select.Member}) and click inside the hut: he walks in. The two at the door hold their positions.

TUT_A1_BRIDGE_REFUSED.text: One at a time on the bridge! The next one waits at the edge.

TUT_A1_REGROUP.title: REGROUP
TUT_A1_REGROUP.text: Press {key:Squad.Regroup} again: Solo ends, the two at the door leave their posts and the squad falls back into formation.

TUT_A1_BOX.title: SELECT A GROUP
TUT_A1_BOX.text: Hold the left mouse button and drag a box over the whole squad, then click the ground: everyone moves together.

WT_A1_BANTER_1.text: Minus thirty and dropping. Watch your hands — fingers go first.

WT_A1_BANTER_2.text: Radio's dead. Not static — dead. Like something is eating the signal.

WT_A1_BANTER_3.text: Forty hours dark. If anyone is still alive up there, they're colder than we are.

WT_A1_BANTER_4.text: Then we don't waste time. Beacons north, eyes open.

WT_A1_GUST.text: Feel that gust? It goes straight through the coat.

TUT_A1_HEATPACK.title: HEAT PACK
TUT_A1_HEATPACK.text: {focus} is the coldest — past 40 % the shivering starts. Select him and press {key:Item.HeatPack} to crack his heat pack, or open the inventory ({key:Inventory.Open}) and drag a mate's pack onto him.

TUT_A1_HEATPACK_MATE.title: HEAT PACK
TUT_A1_HEATPACK_MATE.text: {focus} is still freezing. Same again: select him and press {key:Item.HeatPack}, or drag a heat pack onto him in the inventory ({key:Inventory.Open}).

WT_A1_WARMED.text: Better. The feeling is coming back to my fingers.

TUT_A1_SPRINT.title: DOUBLE-CLICK TO RUN
TUT_A1_SPRINT.text: By the way - running keeps you warm. Double-click the ground ({key:Order.Sprint}) to run there.

WT_A1_RESUPPLY.text: We're nearly out of heat packs. The fishermen's hut is close — let's check it.

WT_A1_HUT.text: Clear. And a crate - fishermen always keep something warm in there.

TUT_A1_LOOT_OPEN.title: SUPPLY CRATE
TUT_A1_LOOT_OPEN.text: Click the crate: the operative inside walks up and opens it.

TUT_A1_LOOT_TAKE.title: TAKE IT
TUT_A1_LOOT_TAKE.text: Take the heat packs: click their line in the crate window, or Take all.

WT_A1_STOCKED.text: Heat packs in the kit. Split them up - nobody walks on without one.

OBJ_A1_SHARE.text: Share the heat packs: everyone carries at least one

TUT_A1_SHARE.title: SHARE THE HEAT PACKS
TUT_A1_SHARE.text: Select the one who took them ({key:Select.Member}), open the inventory ({key:Inventory.Open}), hold Shift and drag a heat pack onto a teammate - his body or his portrait on the action bar. He walks over and hands it over. (Without Shift a cold mate cracks it at once.)

WT_A1_07.text: Formation. Close it up, eyes on the beacons.

WT_A1_08.text: Keep the gaps small. Nobody wanders off alone on this ice.

WT_A1_09.text: The camp is next. I can smell the fish from here.

OBJ_A2_WARM.text: Warm up: push the barrel into the ruin and light it

WT_A2_RUIN_1.text: See that ruin? Three walls and half a roof. Roll the barrel in there.

WT_A2_RUIN_2.text: Good call. Inside, the walls keep the wind off - we can warm up by a barrel in there.

WT_A2_RUIN_3.text: And above all, a fire in there doesn't give us away. An open campfire on the ice is a beacon for anything out there.

WT_A2_01.text: Fingers first, then the trigger finger. We need heat again.

WT_A2_02.text: Barrels by the huts. Fishermen kept fires.

WT_A2_03.text: And matches — we have three. Don't waste them.

WT_A2_04.text: One barrel, one match. Let's find a spot out of the wind.

WT_A2_05.text: Not out here in the wind. Roll it to the hut.

TUT_A2_PUSH.title: PUSH IT INSIDE
TUT_A2_PUSH.text: Click the barrel, choose Push, then click a spot INSIDE the ruin (the ring) - through the wide gap in its wall. Out of a fight it rolls at once; in a fight only in the tactical pause ({key:Time.Pause}).

TUT_A2_LIGHT.title: LIGHT IT
TUT_A2_LIGHT.text: Click the barrel and choose Light (one match). Everyone within 5 m warms up - and inside the walls nobody sees the fire.

TUT_A2_HEATPACK.title: HEAT PACK
TUT_A2_HEATPACK.text: {focus} is freezing again. A heat pack works anywhere: {key:Item.HeatPack}, or drag it onto him in the inventory.

TUT_A2_TOOCOLD.title: TOO COLD TO LIFT
TUT_A2_TOOCOLD.text: Above 80 % cold nobody can push. Select the warmest operative ({key:Select.Member}) and let him do it.

OBJ_A3_OVERLOOK.text: Move up to the overlook - stay low, watch for traps

WT_A3_01.text: That's the complex. The PMC left in a hurry — expect mines and wires on the easy paths.

WT_A3_02.text: Wires at shin height, mines on the shortcuts. Whoever spots one - we disarm it or go round. Watch your step.

WT_A3_03.text: Stay low. Out here low means warm, too.

WT_A1_10.text: Get low. The wind cuts less down there.

WT_A1_11.text: Down if you have to. Crawl if you have to.

WT_A1_12.text: And remember — down low is also how you get under a wire.

TUT_A3_LOW.title: STAY LOW
TUT_A3_LOW.text: Stop. Crouch and move up to the low wall. {key:Stance.Crouch} crouches the selected operative, {key:Stance.Squad.Crouch} the whole squad.

TUT_A1_STANCE.title: STANCE
TUT_A1_STANCE.text: Change stance twice now: {key:Stance.Crouch} crouch, {key:Stance.Prone} prone, {key:Stance.Stand} stand (hold Alt for the whole squad, {key:Stance.Squad.Prone}). Lower = less wind, harder to spot.

TUT_A1_VAULT.title: LOW RIDGE
TUT_A1_VAULT.text: Click the ground beyond the ridge: the squad climbs over low obstacles on its own.

TUT_A3_FENCE.title: LOW FENCE - STOP
TUT_A3_FENCE.text: Too low to walk under - you crawl it, each on his own order. Press {key:Squad.Solo} (Solo): the others hold their spots while you send them one by one.

TUT_A3_FENCE_CRAWL.title: UNDER THE FENCE ({progress} / {count} through)
TUT_A3_FENCE_CRAWL.text: For each operative: select him ({key:Select.Member}), go prone ({key:Stance.Prone}) and click beyond the gap - he crawls under. Any order, at his own pace; several may crawl at once.

TUT_A3_ONE_BY_ONE.text: Not yet - each operative crosses the fence and takes his own cover first.

TUT_A3_COVER_EACH.title: TAKE COVER ONE BY ONE ({progress} / {count} in cover)
TUT_A3_COVER_EACH.text: Stay in Solo. Each one has his own spot - the rings: Medic-Sapper behind the tall slab (blue), Commander at the middle wall (red), Engineer behind the long wall in front (orange). Select him ({key:Select.Member}) and click the wall at his ring.

TUT_A6_COVER.title: COVER
TUT_A6_COVER.text: Click a wall or a ridge to preview a cover slot, click again to take it. Cover also halves the wind.

TUT_A6_SQUAD.title: EVERYONE IN COVER
TUT_A6_SQUAD.text: Press {key:Select.Member} (2 / 3) and give each operative his own cover.

TUT_A3_PEEK.title: CHECK WHAT'S AHEAD
TUT_A3_PEEK.text: Peek around the corner and check what's ahead. Medic-Sapper: in cover behind the slab, click the END of the wall ({key:Cover.CornerPeek}) - she leans out, rifle up; whatever her view cone covers is spotted - mines included, one by one.

TUT_A3_MINE.title: MINE SPOTTED
TUT_A3_MINE.text: The squad stops and holds - move them one by one (B regroups). Go round it, or select the Medic-Sapper ({key:Select.Member} 3), click the mine and choose Defuse — or {key:Attack.TargetedShot} it from more than 4 m.

TUT_A3_WIRE.title: TRIPWIRE
TUT_A3_WIRE.text: A thin wire at shin height with a grenade on each end - walk into it and both go off. Go round it, or disarm it: select an operative and click the red wire (or the ground right beside it - the cursor turns into a hand); he walks up, crouches over it and works a few seconds. From cover he steps out by himself. The Medic-Sapper is best - cold fingers fail; a slip only warns first, click the wire again to retry. Or crawl under it prone ({key:Stance.Prone}).

TUT_A3_WIRE_SPOTTED.text: Tripwire spotted - squad holding. Click the wire and choose Disarm - anyone can try, the Medic-Sapper is best. Or crawl under it prone, one by one.

TUT_A3_MINE_SPOTTED.text: Mine spotted - squad holding. Move them one by one: click it and choose Defuse (the Medic-Sapper is best), go round it, or Ctrl+click it from more than 4 m to blow it.

WT_A3_POSTURE.text: Weapons ready - but nobody shoots first. We fire only if they fire on us.

TUT_A3_POSTURE.title: POSTURE: DEFENSIVE
TUT_A3_POSTURE.text: {key:Posture.Passive} PASSIVE: never fire on their own · {key:Posture.Defensive} DEFENSIVE: never shoot first, fire back when attacked · {key:Posture.Aggressive} AGGRESSIVE: shoot any enemy in sight. Alt + key = the whole squad. Go DEFENSIVE (Alt + {key:Posture.Defensive}): nobody gives you away with a shot, but nobody dies without a fight.

WT_A4_01.text: Contact. Two of them - one walking circles round the near container, the other by the far one. Nobody fire.

WT_A4_02.text: They don't see us yet. We pick the ground, not them.

WT_A4_03.text: The near one first. A wire across his loop and he does our work for us.

TUT_A4_CONES.title: WHAT THEY SEE
TUT_A4_CONES.text: Press {key:View.VisionCones} to show the enemies' vision cones on the ground. Stay out of them — prone you are much harder to spot.

TUT_A4_TRIPWIRE.title: PART 1: TRIPWIRE - {focus} ALONE
TUT_A4_TRIPWIRE.text: {focus} sets the wire for the zombie walking round the NEAR container; the other two hold the overlook as fire support. She is selected (Solo): open the inventory ({key:Inventory.Open}), choose the tripwire and click anchor A, then anchor B across his loop - the marker shows its nearest point. Costs two grenades.

TUT_A4_HIDDEN.title: OUT OF SIGHT
TUT_A4_HIDDEN.text: Prone behind cover they can't see you - but you can't see them either. Peek ({key:Cover.CornerPeek}) or rise ({key:Stance.Crouch} / {key:Stance.Stand}) to look.

OBJ_A4_TRAP.text: {focus}: back behind the low cover - wait until the zombie on the loop walks into the wire

WT_A4_04.text: That's one. The other one is still by the far container.

TUT_A4_SPOTTED.title: SPOTTED - FIGHT BACK
TUT_A4_SPOTTED.text: He has seen you and the game is paused. The squad is PASSIVE - they will not fire back. Switch to DEFENSIVE (Alt + {key:Posture.Defensive}) or AGGRESSIVE (Alt + {key:Posture.Aggressive}), then press {key:Time.Pause} to fight on. A failed ambush is no game over - kill him and the game simply goes on.

TUT_A4_HUG_WALL.title: PART 2: MOVE TACTICALLY - {focus}
TUT_A4_HUG_WALL.text: Now the zombie by the FAR container. Don't walk out in the open: click the wall of the NEAR container - {focus} runs into cover and hugs it, out of his sight. If he spots you, it's just a fight - the game goes on.

TUT_A4_ROUND_CORNER.title: PART 2: ROUND THE CORNER
TUT_A4_ROUND_CORNER.text: In cover, click further along the same container or round its corner: {focus} follows the wall and turns the corner without leaving cover. Stop at the corner that faces the far container.

TUT_A4_LURE.title: PART 2: LURE - {focus}
TUT_A4_LURE.text: The squad stays DEFENSIVE - nobody shoots him first. {focus}: from the corner, or the marker about 10 m from his path, throw a stone {key:Stealth.Throw} between him and you, or whistle {key:Stealth.Whistle} to call him to you. He leaves his path to check the noise. If he spots you, it's just a fight - the game goes on.

TUT_A4_CLOSE_SHOT.title: PART 2: CLOSE SHOT
TUT_A4_CLOSE_SHOT.text: He's coming out into the open. Let him come close - under 10 m, away from the far container - then Ctrl+click him ({key:Attack.TargetedShot}) or switch to AGGRESSIVE (Alt + {key:Posture.Aggressive}). The two at the overlook are free again as fire support.

TUT_A4_CLOSE_SHOT_FAR.text: He's down - but not up close in the open. Next time let him come off his path and close before you shoot.

TUT_PAUSE_ORDERS.title: TACTICAL PAUSE 1/2: TIME STOPS
TUT_PAUSE_ORDERS.text: The fight is paused - the enemies barely move. Give your orders now: select an operative ({key:Select.Member} or click him), then click the ground to move, a wall to take cover, or Ctrl+click an enemy to shoot. Nothing happens yet - each order waits (a cyan marker). Then the next operative.

TUT_PAUSE_RESUME.title: TACTICAL PAUSE 2/2: RESUME
TUT_PAUSE_RESUME.text: Press {key:Time.Resume} to resume - every waiting order starts at once, all together. {key:Time.Pause} pauses again: {pause_charges} pauses per wave (the counter at the top), each ends by itself after {pause_seconds} s; when all are used, they come back {pause_cooldown} s later. The pause when a horde arrives is free and has no time limit. Hold {key:Time.Pause} for the turn-based mode.

TUT_MEDKIT.title: MEDKIT
TUT_MEDKIT.text: {focus} is wounded. Select him ({key:Select.Member}) and press H to use his medkit - or open the inventory ({key:Inventory.Open}) and click Medkit. No medkit left? Select a teammate, open the inventory and drag a medkit onto {focus}, or loot one from a crate.

WT_A7_01.text: Generator shed's dry. And that blast door on the east wall is dead without power.

WT_A7_02.text: Then we make power. Fuel, and something to carry it in.

WT_A7_03.text: Saw an empty jerrycan out by the far container. And the burnt-out BTR in the corner still has diesel in its tank.

OBJ_A7_CANISTER.text: Find the empty jerrycan - follow the marker

TUT_A7_OBJECTIVE.title: OBJECTIVES
TUT_A7_OBJECTIVE.text: The objective list on the right says what to do next; the marker and the arrow at the screen edge show where. Follow it to the jerrycan, then click it to take it.

OBJ_A7_DRAIN.text: Drain diesel from the burnt-out BTR in the yard into the jerrycan

OBJ_A7_GENERATOR.text: Refuel and start the generator in the shed

WT_A7_04.text: She's running. Heat and power - and the turret can draw from her now. Keep the dogs off her.

TUT_A7_PREP.title: THE CONSOLE STARTS THE FIGHT
TUT_A7_PREP.text: Power to the blast door makes noise - the lake will come for you, and the door opens only after the last wave, while the generator runs. Prepare first: set up the turret, mines and barricades from the supply ({key:Deploy.Start}), push barrels and barricades into place, put someone on the high ground. Then use the console by the door.

TUT_A7_TRAPS.title: PREPARE THE GROUND
TUT_A7_TRAPS.text: They will come across the ice and up the gullies. Before the console: the Medic-Sapper strings tripwires across the approaches (inventory {key:Inventory.Open}, the tripwire - two grenades each). The PMC mines you disarmed on the approach are in your kit - lay them ({key:Deploy.Start}); the spare barricades by the compound can close a gap. Keep a way back to the door.

OBJ_A7_TERMINAL.text: When the defence is ready: power the blast door console (it starts the horde)

WT_A8_01.text: Cold Silence, we see a power spike on your grid... and movement on the ice. They heard it. Hold until that door opens.

WT_A8_02.text: Here they come. Keep the generator alive - no power, no door.
